name: New Wave Tropical

description:
New Wave Tropical is an aesthetic design prevalent between the mid-1980s and mid-1990s that blends high-energy rainforest and beach imagery that have motifs from African, Caribbean and Latin cultures with retro-punk, freeform, and art-revival influences. It diffuses a resort-style, playful, leisure vibe with chaos and bold color choices.

Its visual aesthetic is often related to pacific or tropical influences, where it can be found among restaurants, brands, fashion, music covers and interior design
